about:
# Mod Fetcher

<cg>This mod allows you to save and load your mods and configs between computers.</c>

Two new buttons are added to the "Account" menu in "Settings", "<co>Save Mods</c>" and "<co>Load Mods</c>"

[More info (with images) can be found in the repository's README.md](https://github.com/FlyingPig525/modfetcher)

# 1.0.0
- Initial release

## 1.0.1
- Remove iterations

# 1.1.0
- Adds backups
  - Saves a backup of all mods before syncing. If a fatal error occurs, they are restored.

## 1.1.1
- Adds timeouts to server requests (I honestly thought there would be timeouts by default)

## 1.2.0
- removes the fake fatal that sometimes happens :| (i forgot to get rid of it)
- adds a button that toggles all config syncing
